# Let keyboard users close entry dialogs with Escape

## What & Why
Answer and opportunity forms currently require the close button or a save path. Supporting Escape gives keyboard users a predictable way to dismiss an open dialog.

## Done looks like
- Pressing Escape closes answer and opportunity dialogs.
- Escape does not submit or alter the form data.
- The existing dialog accessible name and invalid-field focus behavior remain intact.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
